topic: System Design, Low-Latency Optimization, and RFC Discussions for Apex Platform

messages.text: Team, following our load test yesterday, we are proposing replacing internal JSON serialization between `market-data-gateway` and `order-matching-engine` with Protocol Buffers v3 and gRPC streaming.

replies.text: Strongly support this. We ran synthetic micro-benchmarks on Protobuf vs simdjson: Protobuf showed a 65% reduction in CPU serialization overhead and reduced P99 latency by 140µs.
Please make sure mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE/SPIRE identity attestation is enabled for all inter-pod gRPC channels.

messages.text: Notice: We are increasing Kafka partition count on `trades.matched` from 6 to 12. Partition keys will strictly remain `instrument_id` to guarantee in-order message delivery per symbol.

replies.text: Acknowledged. `trade-settlement-system` consumer group has been updated to scale from 6 to 12 consumer threads. Lag is holding at zero.

messages.text: The real-time spoofing detector in `compliance-surveillance-monitor` triggered 3 false positives during today's market open volatility spike. We are adjusting the cancel-to-fill window from 15s to 30s.

replies.text: Good call Elena. Let's also incorporate volume weighting so high-frequency market makers with large spread quotes aren't inadvertently flagged.

messages.text: TimescaleDB 1-day chunk partitioning migration for `trade_records` completed successfully with zero downtime. Automated compression job is scheduled for 02:00 UTC daily.

replies.text: Great work David. Disk usage metrics look exceptional—we're seeing an 87% compression ratio on historical chunks.

messages.text: The lock-free Disruptor ring buffer implementation in `order-matching-engine` is now merged into staging. Zero heap allocations observed during 250k order/sec stress test.

replies.text: Passed all fuzz testing and sanitizers. Ready for production rollout during Sunday maintenance window.
